reply: Thank you for explaining that money was taken from your benefits card after a merchant refunded a disputed charge directly, and that you were not told why at first. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the merchant's refund confirmation and notes of each call, and ask in writing for a full history of the dispute credit and the reversal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you redeemed membership points for a gift card that you have not been able to use because its billing address cannot be verified. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the redemption confirmation and the card details, and ask in writing how the billing address can be set or how the value can be restored. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged three times for a single payment and that you have not received a response or your money back. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep screenshots of all three charges and your support requests, and report the duplicate charges in writing through the app's dispute process. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
